'''Erik Mikhaylovich Galimov''' ({{langx|ru|Эрик Михайлович Галимов}}; 29 July 1936<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-1893.ln-ru.dl-.pr-inf.uk-0|title=Галимов Э.М. - Общая информация|website=www.ras.ru|access-date=2018-04-14}}</ref> – 24 November 2020) was a Russian [[Geochemistry|geochemist]] and [[Doktor nauk|Doctor of Sciences]].

== Early life==
Galimov was born in [[Vladivostok]]. He graduated from the [[Gubkin Russian State University of Oil and Gas]] in 1959. In 1965, he defended his [[Candidate of Sciences|Candidate]]'s Dissertation. In 1970, he defended his doctoral dissertation. In 1982, he received the title of Professor.

== Career ==
He was Editor-in-Chief of the Russian journal ''Geochemistry'' (since 2005). He was also academician of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] (since 1994),<ref name=":0" /> a Distinguished Professor at the [[Lomonosov Moscow State University]] (since 1999),<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://letopis.msu.ru/content/zasluzhennye-professora-moskovskogo-universiteta|title=Заслуженные профессора Московского университета {{!}} Летопись Московского университета|website=letopis.msu.ru|language=ru|access-date=2018-04-14}}</ref> and director of the Vernadsky Institute of Geochemistry and Analytical Chemistry, RAS (1992—2015).<ref name=":0" />

== Awards and honors ==
He was elected an Honorary Member of the Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Bashkortostan in 2002.
He was elected a Foreign Member of the [[Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur]] in 1998. He received the Alfred E. Treibs Award from the Geochemical Society in 2004.
He was a Geochemistry Fellow in the Geochemical Society and European Association of Geochemistry (1998).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.geochemsoc.org/awards/geochemicalfellows/|title=Geochemical Fellows :: Geochemical Society|website=www.geochemsoc.org|language=en|access-date=2018-04-14|archive-date=2016-11-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161116210243/https://www.geochemsoc.org/awards/geochemicalfellows/|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was also a laureate of the 2015 [[State Prize of the Russian Federation]].

== Death ==
He died on 24 November 2020, aged 84 from COVID-19.<ref>[https://ria.ru/20201124/galimov-1586051504.html Умер академик Эрик Галимов, руководивший программами по изучению Луны] {{in lang|ru}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.mk.ru/social/2020/11/24/koronavirus-unes-zhizn-myatezhnogo-akademika-erika-galimova.html | title=Коронавирус унес жизнь мятежного академика Эрика Галимова | date=24 November 2020 }}</ref>
